125601.overview: It's Virtua Fighter 2 versus Fighting Vipers! Two arcade smash hits, smashing into each other in the ultimate battle for supremacy. It's cutting edge combat. It's also filled with surprises - try to unlock your favourite characters from Daytona USA and Virtua Cop! This is fighting like you've never experienced before!

125602.overview: Frogger is a 1981 arcade game developed by Konami. It is regarded as a classic from the golden age of video arcade games, noted for its novel gameplay and theme. The object of the game is to direct frogs to their homes one by one by crossing a busy road and navigating a river full of hazards.
